name: Reproductive Endocrinologist & IVF Consultant
nameAr: استشاري طب الخصوبة والغدد الصماء التناسلية
experienceReq: Minimum 5-8 years specialized clinical experience post-fellowship with subspecialty board certification (e.g., CCT/Subspecialty RCOG, American Board REI).
summary: Specialist physicians dedicated to diagnosing and treating male and female infertility, recurrent pregnancy loss, hormonal imbalances, and conducting assisted reproductive treatments including IVF, ICSI, and fertility preservation.

faqs.q: What qualifications should I check for an IVF doctor in Dubai?
faqs.a: Check that the physician holds a Consultant or Specialist license from the Dubai Health Authority (DHA) or DHCR, with formal fellowship training in Reproductive Endocrinology and Infertility (REI).

faqs.q: When should couples consult a fertility specialist in Dubai?
faqs.a: Couples are advised to seek evaluation if they haven't conceived after 12 months of unprotected intercourse (or after 6 months if the female partner is 35 or older).

name: Consultant Cardiologist & Heart Specialist
experienceReq: Board certification in Cardiovascular Disease (American Board, UK CCT/MRCP, European Board of Cardiology) with ACLS master credentialing.
summary: Expert physicians managing coronary artery disease, heart failure, cardiac arrhythmias, high blood pressure, and performing non-invasive echocardiography and interventional cardiac catheterization.

faqs.q: What does a first cardiology consultation in Dubai include?
faqs.a: A standard initial consultation includes a comprehensive cardiovascular risk assessment, resting 12-lead ECG, blood pressure evaluation, and review of lipid blood markers.

faqs.q: How can I prepare for a treadmill cardiac stress test?
faqs.a: Wear comfortable running shoes and lightweight clothing, avoid heavy meals and caffeine for 4 hours before the test, and consult your doctor about taking morning blood pressure medications.

name: Consultant Orthopedic & Joint Surgeon
nameAr: استشاري جراحة العظام والمفاصل والعمود الفقري
experienceReq: Fellowship in Orthopedic Surgery (FRCS Orth, American Board of Orthopaedic Surgery, German Facharzt) with verified surgical logbooks.
summary: Specialized surgeons performing robotic joint replacements, keyhole arthroscopy for ACL tears, rotator cuff repairs, complex trauma fixation, and spinal disc surgeries.

faqs.q: How do I know if I need total knee replacement surgery?
faqs.a: Surgery is indicated when severe knee arthritis causes constant debilitating pain that limits everyday walking, cannot be controlled by medications or injections, and shows bone-on-bone contact on X-rays.

faqs.q: What is the recovery period for an ACL reconstruction in Dubai?
faqs.a: Patients walk with braces within days, achieve full knee flexion by 6 weeks, and return to competitive pivoting sports between 6 to 9 months with guided sports physiotherapy.

name: Consultant Dermatologist & Aesthetic Specialist
experienceReq: Specialist or Consultant Dermatology licensing (American Board of Dermatology, Arab Board, MRCP Derm, European Board).
summary: Physicians specializing in clinical disorders of skin, hair, and nails, providing advanced medical treatments for chronic skin conditions, laser therapy, and evidence-based aesthetic rejuvenation.

faqs.q: Does a dermatologist treat severe hair loss in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, dermatologists specialize in trichology, diagnosing androgenetic alopecia, telogen effluvium, and alopecia areata via trichoscopy and prescribing PRP, minoxidil, and targeted biological treatments.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a dermatologist and a cosmetologist?
faqs.a: A dermatologist is a medical doctor (MD) licensed to diagnose skin diseases, perform skin biopsies, and prescribe medical drugs; a cosmetologist focuses on non-medical cosmetic and surface beauty treatments.
